boundary.start: fresh-game boundary with explicit projection inputs
boundary.stop: normal return followed by exit snapshot

profile.safety: exclude every out-of-bounds write; stop before an invalid destination

exclusions.reason: This projection observes every unit damage and city shield slot, all goal roles and listed counters, not the remaining world fields enumerated in the registry.

Rule definitions, text/name storage and remaining preference fields have separate content and world-entry tests; this projection only observes the listed cursors, flags, substitutions and preferences.
The admitted runtime is quiescent. Pending-operation and transport-output rejection, RNG preservation and identity generations have separate runtime tests.

limitations: Independent specification expectations for the declared projection; no original-game capture or independent fixture review is claimed.
All backing slots are included even beyond scan bounds. Other world/process/session state is excluded explicitly; this is not full setup or whole-state conformance.
No pending command or transport output at entry. Lifecycle guard and cold/reused/cancelled/failed world-entry integration remain separate portable tests.
